# DataPipe browser client

Vendored from `https://unpkg.com/datapipe-client@0.2.0/dist/datapipe-client.browser.global.js`.
Version: 0.2.0. Framework-neutral official client by the jsPsych team.
`LICENSE.datapipe-client` contains its MIT license. Bundled Firebase notices are retained inside the JavaScript file.

Reference: https://github.com/jspsych/datapipe/tree/main/packages/client

No CDN script is needed at runtime. Live collection still connects to DataPipe and its Firebase staging database.
